summary:
Main
Today, the iron ore market showed a weaker trend on the Dalian Commodity Exchange (DCE). The main contract I2609 closed at 739 yuan/ton,down 0.27% from the previous trading session. Spot prices at Qingdao Port fell by 1-3 yuan/ton from the previous day.
